name: Southern Qiandong Miao
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Xia Yongliang. 1984. Rongjiang Gaotong miaoyu yuyin chutan [Phonology sketch of Gaotong Miao, Rongjiang] (Chinese journal, not online)

sources.note: Bibliographic page only; sole descriptive ref = Xia Yongliang 1984. Na Meo is a separate languoid (name1237, ISO neo).

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en). 'Hmu language', wikitext as of 2026-09-17 (bibliography: Wang Fushi 1985; Wu Zhengbiao 2009; Li & Li 2012; Li Yunbing 2000; Hsiu 2015, 2018).
sources.note: Secondary, uncited tone section: 'All dialects have eight tones. There is no sandhi.' Southern Hmu = Zhenmin (Rongshui) tones 33/53/35/31/44/22(breathy)/24/213; orthography note 'Neutral tone / no tone: unmarked'. No stress statement.

sources.citation: Hsiu, Andrew. 2018. Preliminary classification of Hmongic languages. East Asian Language Phyla Project (sites.google.com/site/eastasianphyla/hmong-mien/hmongic/).
sources.note: Classification tree only (Hmuic: North-East / West-Raojia / South); no descriptive or prosodic content.

sources.citation: Hsiu, Andrew. 2015. The classification of Na Meo, a Hmong-Mien language of Vietnam. Handout, SEALS 25, Chiang Mai, 27-29 May 2015. 16 pp. doi:10.5281/zenodo.1127804
sources.note: Nothing. Comparative lexical handout: Southern Qiandong datapoints Zhenmin, Guncen, Yaogao (Rongshui, Guangxi), Datu (Libo), Yangpai (Danzhai) with tone values/tone-class numbers 1-8 on every form (data from Chen Qiguang 2013, Li Yunbing 2000, Guangxi 2008); no word on stress, accent or prominence.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (zh). '苗语黔东方言', wikitext as of 2026-09-17 (参考文献: 王辅世 1985 苗语简志; 王春德 1986; 李云兵 2000; 吴正彪 2009).
sources.note: Secondary: '黔东方言各土语都有八个声调，没有连读变调现象。' Southern sub-dialect (南部土语, ~500,000 speakers, Congjiang/Rongjiang/Danzhai/Rongshui/Sanjiang) representative point 振民村, 红水乡, 融水县. Nothing on 重音/轻声.

sources.citation: Wang, Fushi 王辅世 (ed.). 1985. 苗语简志 [A sketch of the Miao language]. Beijing: 民族出版社.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: The standard sketch; its Qiandong chapter is the source of the eight-tone/no-sandhi statements and the Zhenmin (Rongshui) southern-sub-dialect notes reproduced on Wikipedia; would settle whether the description mentions stress or 轻声 at all. Same book would also serve nort2747 and east2370.

sources.citation: Liu, Wen 刘文. 2021. 语音学田野调查方法与实践: 黔东苗语(新寨)个案研究 [Phonetic fieldwork methods and practice: a case study of Qiandong Miao (Xinzhai)]. Jinan: 山东大学出版社. OCLC 1294545225.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Only instrumental phonetic study of a Qiandong Miao point found; would give acoustic evidence on tone and any prominence. Caveat: the Xinzhai point's sub-dialect (northern vs southern) is unverified, so identity must be checked first.

sources.citation: Chen, Qiguang 陈其光. 2013. 苗瑶语文 [Miao and Yao languages]. Beijing: 中央民族大学出版社.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Per Hsiu 2015 it carries the Zhenmin and Yaogao Southern Qiandong data (informant Wei Guiming, 1985) with full tone values; a modern comprehensive treatment likely to state whether Hmongic varieties have word stress.

sources.citation: Guangxi Minority Languages Orthography Committee 广西壮族自治区少数民族语言文字工作委员会. 2008. 广西民族语言方音词汇 [Vocabularies of Guangxi ethnic languages]. Beijing: 民族出版社.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: ~4,000 items for the Guncen (Rongshui) southern point (informant He Xinlin, p. 793 per Hsiu 2015); such 方音词汇 volumes usually open with a short phonological system per point, where a 轻声 note could sit.

sources.citation: Xia, Yongliang 夏永梁. 1984. 榕江高塘苗语语音初探 [A preliminary study of the phonology of Gaotang Miao, Rongjiang]. 贵州民族研究 1984: 97-107.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Glottolog's only descriptive reference for sout2754 and the only phonology sketch of a Rongjiang (southern sub-dialect) point; a Chinese 语音 sketch of this era normally has a 音节/声调 section where any 轻声/重音 remark would appear. Not located online or at Harvard; CNKI coverage of the journal for 1984 unverified.

sources.citation: Ma, Xueliang 马学良 & Tai, Changhou 邰昌厚. 1956. 贵州省东南部苗语语音的初步比较 [A preliminary comparison of the phonology of the Miao dialects of southeastern Guizhou]. 语言研究 1: 265-282.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Earliest comparative phonology across Qiandong points including southern ones; listed in Wikipedia further reading; could contain the first prosodic remarks.
